## History

After being orphaned around the age of twelve, Henry Warren was taken in by his uncle Tom and aunt. He endured severe abuse, beatings, and starvation from his relatives, which caused him to develop epilepsy and simple-mindedness. Henry lived as a simple youth until he died at approximately eighteen years of age.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXIX. A WEIRD TALE P9](../source/v05-c29.md#nw-v05-c29-p0009)_
